name: Closer To God
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the importance of drawing near to God with genuine hearts, as seen when Israel humbled themselves with fasting, weeping, and offerings before the LORD (Judges 20:26). Trusting in God and seeking closeness to Him is declared good and necessary for a faithful life (Psalms 73:28), while God Himself affirms His nearness to His people (Jeremiah 23:23). True closeness to God demands sincere devotion rather than outward show, warning against hypocrisy in spiritual disciplines like fasting (Matthew 6:16), and calls for purity of heart, as Jesus teaches that even inward lust distances us from God’s holiness (Matthew 5:28).
